viewer-demo-journey.name: Complete desktop weather viewer journey
viewer-demo-journey.description: The public user opens the fixed Colombia scenario, verifies wind at 06Z, selects SKBO, switches layers and timestamps, uses playback, resets, and reloads the deterministic desktop demo.

viewer-catalog-recovery.name: Recover from an unavailable weather catalog
viewer-catalog-recovery.description: The viewer keeps its shell and map visible, disables weather controls, explains the catalog failure and lets the user retry once MapLibre is ready.
knownGaps: Intentional E2E exemption: Phase 08 authorizes exactly one desktop journey spec. Directed orchestrator tests cover failure and retry; the contingency rehearsal validates the browser-visible recovery.

viewer-airports-recovery.name: Recover airports without blocking weather
viewer-airports-recovery.description: Weather remains usable when airport GeoJSON fails, while the airport panel explains the failure and offers an independent retry.
knownGaps: Intentional E2E exemption: the independent failure and retry are covered by directed orchestrator tests and the Phase 08 manual rehearsal; no second Playwright spec is authorized.

viewer-frame-recovery.name: Preserve and retry a failed synchronized frame
viewer-frame-recovery.description: A failed weather or selected-airport request preserves the complete previous view, pauses playback and exposes retry and reset actions.
knownGaps: Intentional E2E exemption: races, aborts, atomic preservation and retry are covered by directed orchestrator tests; Phase 08 rehearses the visible contingency manually.

viewer-wind-fallback.name: Continue with static wind arrows
viewer-wind-fallback.description: If the particle renderer cannot run, the viewer announces fallback, shows static wind arrows and keeps selectors and timeline usable.
knownGaps: Intentional E2E exemption: renderer fallback has directed renderer/orchestrator coverage and belongs to the required Phase 08 manual contingency rehearsal.

viewer-map-recovery.name: Explain and retry map initialization failure
viewer-map-recovery.description: A MapLibre initialization failure shows a map-specific error and retry without hiding the permanent simulated-data warning.
knownGaps: Intentional E2E exemption: shell/controller tests cover retryable and non-retryable map states; Phase 08 validates the target browsers manually.
